scientific_integrity: Exact formulas and a complete analytic proof are supplied; finite high-precision checks are supplementary and do not establish universal inequalities. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Three states, two irreversible serial constant-rate jumps, one exact exponential Strang step and worst-initial-probability total-variation error. No general splitting-order or multi-step guarantee; historical priority is provisional because a relevant 2018 conference article was abstract-only.
title: All-step Strang ordering and exact rate-two resonance for a serial Markov reaction chain
